name: Ordering Width of an Even Cycle
scope: Ordering width $\sigma$ under the database definition.
proof: The lower bound follows by taking the first prefix whose cyclic gaps all have length below $d$ and applying the first-two predecessor bound to the two new gaps. For the upper bound, order one semicircle consecutively, insert the midpoint of the remaining gap, and then finish arbitrarily; every minimal predecessor disagreement then has size at most $\lceil d/2\rceil$.
